Simple strategy artifact 22 August 2026 · material/example
What this is about

This plan promises a halving nobody costed, and a job cut nobody named.

Cost falls when work stops.
Nothing in the folder has a date for stopping.

Three things must be solved
1

The 50 percent cut has no base year.

(invented-memo.md p. 4)

Two readings sit in one room. One is a trend the plan already meets. The other is a cut it has not started. While both live, no meeting can close.

2

Five hundred people must go, and only hiring is funded.

(vision-2030.md p. 6)

The plan saves money by changing who works there. The vision saves money by having fewer people. The folder never adds the two together.

3

Everything the vision stops is being paid for through 2027.

(vision-2030.md p. 3 and p. 4)

You do not rebuild a channel you are closing. This is the only mechanism the other two problems have. If the money keeps flowing here, they have no route.

What we stop doing
Stops
  • Leading on the four ratio numbers.
  • The two hiring lines, or the budget that pays for them.
  • the service-desk build and the manned-channel agent.
  • The 1.3m email saving, or the phase-out.
Starts
  • A money section that reaches 2030.
  • A name against the 500.
  • A date against each of the four stops.
  • A price for the security step-up.

Sixteen items with their sources are in the reasoning log. The folder gives no date for a single one of the stops.

What has to be true

The heaviest: shift-left has to remove work rather than move it. The plan hands configuration to the commercial unit. The vision shrinks the commercial unit. If the work only moves, the division hits its target and the group saves nothing.

All five bets, with what would test each one, are in the reasoning log.

What the documents disagree about

The money follows hiring, not the cut. It follows manned channels surviving. It follows selling email, not phasing it out. Eight times the same answer.

All eight, with both sides quoted, are in the reasoning log.

What we do not know

Eleven things. Three block a decision on their own. Which cost lines the 50 percent covers. The headcount baseline. Who is in the room.

Three documents are named in the material and are not in the folder. The workforce plan behind 1400 to 900. Any price for the security step-up. Any figure at all for 2029 and 2030.

What this page cannot tell you. Neither the vision nor the brainstorm carries a date. So nobody here can tell which came first. If the plan came first, every problem above is a gap. If the vision came first, they are choices already made against it. That one fact would re-rank this page.

This run demoted eighteen further findings and deleted none. Five reach this page. Thirteen are in the reasoning log.
